# ResultCrafter

> Result pattern for ASP.NET Core (.NET 10 and later). Services return `Result<T>`, `Result` or `Error`; one call at
> the endpoint turns it into a typed success response or an RFC 9457 ProblemDetails error. Minimal API first, MVC
> controllers supported, NativeAOT-safe. Five NuGet packages under `ResultCrafter.*`. Current version: 3.1.0.

Register with `builder.Services.AddResultCrafter()` and `app.UseResultCrafter()`. Map every result at the endpoint
(`ToOkResult()`, `ToCreatedResult()`, `ToAcceptedResult()`, `ToNoContentResult()`, `ToProblemResult()`); returning a
`Result` or `Error` unmapped throws.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/README.md): what it is, a short example, install.
- [Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/docs/guide.md): every feature with examples: errors, results, Minimal API and MVC mapping, validation, field error codes, EF Core, configuration, limitations.
- [Migrating to 3.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/docs/migrating-to-3.md): breaking changes from 2.x and what to do.

## Packages

- [ResultCrafter.AspNetCore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/src/ResultCrafter.AspNetCore/README.md): maps results to HTTP; ProblemDetails, exception handling, logging, OpenAPI helpers.
- [ResultCrafter.Core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/src/ResultCrafter.Core/README.md): the `Result<T>`, `Result` and `Error` types, no ASP.NET Core dependency.
- [ResultCrafter.AspNetCore.EfCore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/src/ResultCrafter.AspNetCore.EfCore/README.md): EF Core concurrency conflicts as 409.
- [ResultCrafter.FluentValidation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/src/ResultCrafter.FluentValidation/README.md): validator failures as `Error.BadRequest`.
- [ResultCrafter.AspNetCore.FluentValidation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/src/ResultCrafter.AspNetCore.FluentValidation/README.md): `WithValidation<T>()` endpoint filter.

## Optional

- [Design and performance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/docs/design.md): why the types look the way they do.
- [How it compares](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/docs/comparison.md): against Ardalis.Result, ErrorOr, FluentResults, OneOf and LanguageExt.
- [Return or throw?](https://dev.to/haikasatryan/return-or-throw-result-pattern-vs-exceptions-in-aspnet-core-1nl5): article on the Result pattern versus exceptions: pros, cons, benchmark numbers and one rule for choosing.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaikAsatryan/ResultCrafter/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): build, test, AOT smoke test.
